notes.title: Steam Workshop Full Integration Update
notes.content: [p]Kurisu v1.3.0 now features full Steam Workshop upload functionality! Users can edit, configure, and upload workshop items directly through the application interface.[/p][p][b]Key New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Direct Workshop Access[/b] - Access workshop functionality directly from main interface[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Editor[/b] - Configure projects through graphical interface without manual JSON editing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-Command Management[/b] - Create, edit, and manage multiple FFmpeg commands[/p][/*][*][p][b]Real-time Preview[/b] - Instantly preview configuration effects[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-language Support[/b] - Support for Chinese, English, Japanese and other languages[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Detailed Usage Guide[/b][/p][p][b]1. Workshop Project Configuration[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Project ID[/b]: Enter a unique numeric ID (e.g., 1001, 1002, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Project Name[/b]: Name your workshop project[/p][/*][*][p][b]Project Family[/b]: Specify the series or category of the project[/p][/*][*][p][b]Project Description[/b]: Detailed description of project functionality and purpose[/p][/*][*][p][b]Usage Instructions[/b]: Provide user guidance[/p][/*][/list][p][b]2. FFmpeg Command Configuration[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Command Name[/b]: Assign an easily recognizable name for each FFmpeg command[/p][/*][*][p][b]Command Description[/b]: Brief explanation of the command's purpose[/p][/*][*][p][b]FFmpeg Command[/b]: Enter the complete FFmpeg processing command[/p][/*][/list][p][b]3. Path Variables Explanation[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Input File Path Variable[/b]: ${filePath} - User-selected input file path[/p][/*][*][p][b]Output File Path Variable[/b]: ${outputPath} - System-generated output file path[/p][/*][*][p][b]Command Example[/b]: ffmpeg -i ${filePath} -y -c:v libx264 -crf 23 ${outputPath}${.mp4}[/p][/*][/list][p][b]4. Upload Process[/b][/p][olist][*][p]After configuration, click "Choose Preview Image" to upload project cover[/p][/*][*][p]Click "Upload to Workshop" to start the upload process[/p][/*][*][p]System will automatically process and publish to Steam Workshop[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: 1.2.0Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone! In the latest version of the Steam software update, we’ve introduced some exciting new features to enhance your experience and improve the overall usability.

Key Features:
	1.	New AI Smart Judging Function:
We’ve integrated a brand-new AI system that intelligently determines your intent when uploading multiple files. The AI will automatically assess whether you’re looking to batch process these files or combine them into a single one, then perform the appropriate operation accordingly. This will significantly streamline file management and processing tasks.
	2.	Resolution Information Support:
The software now provides resolution information to the AI, allowing for more accurate file handling and processing. This is particularly beneficial for users who require specific formats or resolution adjustments, ensuring a smoother and more personalized experience.

Thank you for your continuous support and feedback! We’ll keep working on improving the software to provide you with an even better experience. If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to reach out to us!

notes.content:

notes.title: Welcome to purchasing Kurisu!!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Welcome to purchasing this software!![/h1][/b]
Kurisu is a natural language-based audio, video, and image processing tool built on FFmpeg. Here, we will introduce what Kurisu/FFmpeg can do.
[h2][b]About FFmpeg[/b][/h2]
FFmpeg is a leading multimedia framework, able to decode, encode, transcode, mux, demux, stream, filter, and play almost anything that humans and machines have created. It supports the most obscure ancient formats up to the cutting edge formats. Whether they were created by some standards committee, the community, or a corporation, FFmpeg can handle them. ————Excerpt from FFmpeg's official website (https://ffmpeg.org/)
[b][h2]What Can Kurisu Do[/h2][/b]
Kurisu can perform most of the functions listed above that FFmpeg can do. Therefore, when using it, you can check what FFmpeg can do.
Typing in commands based on what FFmpeg can accomplish will increase your chances of success and accuracy. Because if your request is something that FFmpeg cannot do, then the results are likely to not meet your expectations. If your request is something that FFmpeg can do, then using it should be quite comfortable.
If your description is detailed and professional enough, the success rate will greatly increase. If it is too vague, the AI might not understand your intent.
[b][h2]Based on FFmpeg?[/h2][/b]
Yes. The core functionalities are all accomplished by FFmpeg. This program also adheres to the protocol and is open source under the GPLv3 license at https://www.github.com/mcdfsteve/kurisu .
[b][h2]What to Do If It Malfunctions?[/h2][/b]
Those who have used ChatGPT should understand; you can try several times or change the keywords.
If you have any questions or encounter any bugs, you can visit www.dfsteve.top.
